blockers.detail: No independently addressable clean-frame bytes are present in the audited snapshot or platform data.
The platform asset records do not contain immutable SHA-256 provenance for a clean frame.
No deterministic clean-to-annotated object mapping or mapping version is available.
Overlay status is not recorded as clean, overlay, or unknown with auditable evidence.
No verified transform maps annotated-image candidate coordinates to clean-frame pixels.
Dataset isolation cannot be proven by clean-frame SHA-256 until clean provenance exists.
The local import dropped the upstream task relationship; generated annex row IDs are not event, video, or track groups.
Input-only audit found 22 of 30 recoverable tasks on both selection and locked-test sides, affecting 198 of 215 gold-input images.
Stored capture_time is attachment create_time rather than the available upstream event_time.

protected_gold_access_incident.remediation: The auditor no longer opens authoring, full gold, locked gold, or quarantine files by default; it only compares recorded manifest/SHA256SUMS digests and stat sizes. --include-protected-gold is required to open, parse, and verify protected content.

cache.encoding: Pillow JPEG quality=95 derivative; filename is upstream payload SHA-256, not cached-byte SHA-256
cache.note: Color screening used re-encoded pixel derivatives, not immutable upstream object bytes; the cache is not proof that the source is clean.
